name: Detroit
registryBasis: The City of Detroit Open Data Portal publishes an Office of the Assessor parcel layer. Its polygon schema provides safe keys object_id and parcel_number. A bounded exact WUP-point query returned one polygon using only those two fields plus geometry; no owner, address or assessment values were requested or retained.

verifiedParcelResponse.source: City of Detroit Office of the Assessor Parcels_Current (FeatureServer layer 0)
verifiedParcelResponse.request: exact WUP-point intersection; outFields=object_id,parcel_number; returnGeometry=true; resultRecordCount=3; outSR=4326
verifiedParcelResponse.attributePolicy: Only object_id, parcel_number and geometry were requested and retained. No owner, address, assessment, taxpayer, sale or other parcel fields were requested.

queries.query: Detroit official open data parcel polygon GIS parcel ID City of Detroit feature service
queries.scope: Locate city-specific registry/cadastre evidence and verify anonymous bounded parcel geometry without private fields.
queries.result: The City Open Data Portal and Office of the Assessor service identify a Polygon parcel layer. A bounded exact WUP-point query requested only object_id, parcel_number and geometry and returned one full Polygon. No other attributes were requested or retained.
queries.executionMethod: Official layer metadata inspected first; then one anonymous exact-point GET limited to EPSG:4326 geometry, object_id and parcel_number, max 3 features. No private/assessment fields requested or read.

queries.query: Detroit datos abiertos mapa parcelas polígono GIS parcel_id oficial ciudad
queries.scope: Locate city-specific registry/cadastre evidence and verify anonymous bounded parcel geometry without private fields.
queries.result: The City’s Spanish-language GIS department page links to its open data/GIS resources. The official assessor endpoint is the same source published in the English-language search; no personal property lookup was made.
queries.executionMethod: Separate Spanish-language and English-language source discovery; review limited to official city pages and schema-safe geometry request. No owner/address/assessment values requested or retained.

scopeLimits: 200 valid distinct Detroit Office of the Assessor current parcel polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP locator. Complete viewports, ten forced three-row pages, all 200 fresh native parcel_number reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed in 32 public requests. Native parcel numbers retain their dots, hyphens and combined-lot suffixes exactly; object_id is transport paging identity only. Only these two schema-verified safe identifiers and full geometry are queried or retained. Independent metric EPSG:32617 GEOS found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The exact WUP point lies in source geometry. Wider municipal completeness, title, survey accuracy and long-term key continuity remain unverified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
